qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A person who knows and can speak many languages
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त एक शब्द चुनिए:
A person who knows and can speak many languages
e: A 'polyglot' knows and uses several languages. A 'linguist' studies language scientifically.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A disease that spreads by physical contact from one person to another
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A disease that spreads by physical contact from one person to another
e: 'Contagious' refers to a disease transmissible by direct or indirect contact.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
One who walks in sleep
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
One who walks in sleep
e: A 'somnambulist' walks while asleep; a 'somniloquist' talks in sleep.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A government run by the wealthy class
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A government run by the wealthy class
e: 'Plutocracy' is government by the wealthy. 'Aristocracy' is by nobility; 'theocracy' is by religious leaders.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: EXUBERANT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: EXUBERANT
e: 'Exuberant' means full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness—closest to 'Joyful'.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: DAINTY
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: DAINTY
e: 'Dainty' means delicately small and pretty.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: PERNICIOUS
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: PERNICIOUS
e: 'Pernicious' means having a harmful or destructive effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: DESPISED
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: DESPISED
e: 'Despised' means strongly disliked or looked down upon; its antonym is 'Loved'.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: VOLATILE
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: VOLATILE
e: 'Volatile' means liable to change rapidly; its opposite is 'Constant'.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: MINOR
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: MINOR
e: 'Minor' (lesser/small) is directly opposite to 'Major'.

qe:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom:
To spill the beans
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे (Idiom) का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To spill the beans
e: 'To spill the beans' means to disclose secret or confidential information.

qe:
Complete the proverb:
Barking dogs ______ bite.
qh:
कहावत को पूरा कीजिए:
Barking dogs ______ bite.
e: The standard proverb is 'Barking dogs seldom bite', meaning people who threaten loudly rarely act.

qe:
Select the meaning of the underlined idiom:
He decided to 'burn the midnight oil' before the BPSC exam.
qh:
रेखांकित मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
He decided to 'burn the midnight oil' before the BPSC exam.
oe: Stay up late studying or working
oh: Stay up late studying or working
e: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to read or work late into the night.

qe:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word:
The patient was very weak after surgery, yet he ______ with proper care.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त विकल्प चुनिए:
The patient was very weak after surgery, yet he ______ with proper care.
e: 'Pulled through' is a phrasal verb meaning to recover from a serious illness or difficulty.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
She missed the morning train ______ she woke up late.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
She missed the morning train ______ she woke up late.
e: 'Because' introduces the reason/cause for missing the train.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
He has been living in Patna ______ 2018.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
He has been living in Patna ______ 2018.
e: 'Since' is used with a specific starting point in time (2018); 'for' is used with durations.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Neither the manager nor the clerks ______ present at the meeting.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Neither the manager nor the clerks ______ present at the meeting.
e: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('clerks' is plural => 'were').

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Everyone immediately ______ him because of his distinctive voice.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Everyone immediately ______ him because of his distinctive voice.
e: 'Recognized' fits contextually—identifying someone from their voice.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
You ______ obey the traffic rules to avoid accidents.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
You ______ obey the traffic rules to avoid accidents.
e: 'Must' expresses strong obligation or necessity.

qe:
Identify the segment in the sentence that contains a grammatical error:
One of my friend (A) / lives in (B) / Muzaffarpur. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
One of my friend (A) / lives in (B) / Muzaffarpur. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'One of' must be followed by a plural noun: 'One of my friends'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
He is suffering (A) / from fever (B) / since Monday. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
He is suffering (A) / from fever (B) / since Monday. (C) / No error (D)
e: With 'since + point of time', use Present Perfect Continuous: 'He has been suffering'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
The sceneries of (A) / Darjeeling are (B) / very charming. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
The sceneries of (A) / Darjeeling are (B) / very charming. (C) / No error (D)
e: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and has no plural 'sceneries'; it should be 'The scenery of Darjeeling is...'.

qe:
Improve the bracketed part of the sentence:
He (did not wrote) a letter to his father.
qh:
कोष्ठक में दिए गए भाग को सुधारने के लिए सही विकल्प चुनिए:
He (did not wrote) a letter to his father.
e: 'Did not' is always followed by the base form (V1) of the verb: 'did not write'.

qe:
Convert the sentence into Passive Voice:
The peon opened the gate.
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलिए:
The peon opened the gate.
oe: The gate had opened by the peon.
The gate was opening by the peon.
The gate is opened by the peon.
The gate was opened by the peon.
oh: The gate had opened by the peon.
The gate was opening by the peon.
The gate is opened by the peon.
The gate was opened by the peon.
e: Simple Past active ('opened') becomes 'was/were + V3' in passive: 'The gate was opened by the peon.'

qe:
Convert into Indirect Speech:
Ramesh said, "I am reading a novel."
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Indirect Speech में बदलिए:
Ramesh said, "I am reading a novel."
oe: Ramesh said that I was reading a novel.
Ramesh said that he was reading a novel.
Ramesh said that he is reading a novel.
Ramesh told that he was reading a novel.
oh: Ramesh said that I was reading a novel.
Ramesh said that he was reading a novel.
Ramesh said that he is reading a novel.
Ramesh told that he was reading a novel.
e: Reporting verb in past ('said') shifts Present Continuous ('am reading') to Past Continuous ('was reading').

qe: Select the correctly spelt word:
qh: सही वर्तनी (Correct Spelling) वाला शब्द चुनिए:
e: 'Accommodation' has double 'c' and double 'm'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (1):
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (1) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
e: 'Vital role' is the natural collocation meaning an essential/important role.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (2):
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (2) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
e: Libraries 'provide' free access to books and resources.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (3):
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (3) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
e: 'All walks of life' is a standard idiom meaning people from all social and economic backgrounds.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (4):
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (4) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Public libraries play a (1)____ role in promoting lifelong learning. They (2)____ free access to books, journals, and digital resources for students from all (3)____ of life. A strong library system helps (4)____ literacy and informed citizenship.
e: 'Foster' means to encourage or promote the development of literacy.
